steps.description: This is a machine learning investigation concerning bootstrap resampling, neural network generalization, and solution space rigidity (Hessian analysis), not a materials science or physics simulation. plans.objective: [DIM: composition] The Ca/Si/Al/O stoichiometry of the glass network controls the defect density of structural voids, which in turn modulates the effective activation energy for ion migration via a percolation threshold.

steps.description: The hypothesis links Ca/Si/Al/O stoichiometry to defect density and ion migration activation energy via a percolation threshold. This requires exploring the compositional design space to identify where the percolation threshold occurs and how void density modulates migration barriers. We will systematically vary composition parameters, simulate glass structures, compute void metrics and ion migration barriers, and map the relationship to identify the critical percolation point.
